title: 3681. Maximum XOR of Subsequences

examples.explanation: Choose subsequences: First subsequence [2], whose XOR is 2. Second subsequence [2,3], whose XOR is 1. Then, XOR of both subsequences = 2 XOR 1 = 3. This is the maximum XOR value achievable from any two subsequences.

Choose subsequences: First subsequence [5], whose XOR is 5. Second subsequence [2], whose XOR is 2. Then, XOR of both subsequences = 5 XOR 2 = 7. This is the maximum XOR value achievable from any two subsequences.
